tools.name: get_authoring_guide
tools.description: Returns Docmino's MDX authoring documentation for document and page content, including supported interactive component props and working examples. The default guide covers common components; a component selection returns focused schemas and examples with companion components included automatically.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search accessible Docmino documents by name and summary.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve a Docmino document. Large documents include explicit continuation instructions.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List your personal workspace and organization workspaces.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Search and paginate documents accessible in a workspace. Omit workspaceId for your account.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List accessible projects, including shared projects.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Retrieve an accessible project's details and canonical Docmino link.

tools.name: list_project_documents
tools.description: Paginate the documents accessible in a project.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get the full editable document snapshot and revision. Preserve the full page tree when saving.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open the rich Docmino editor with explicit Save. Use Docmino for uploads and AI assistance.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List all document pages without content, including nesting, and the current revision.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read document root content or a named page in chunks. Check revision across chunks.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Creates a Docmino document with MDX content and an optional nested page tree. Supported interactive component syntax and examples are available from get_authoring_guide.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Updates MDX document content and the authoritative page tree using expectedRevision for conflict detection. Omitted existing pages are deleted and require deletion permission. Supported interactive component syntax and examples are available from get_authoring_guide.

tools.name: move_document
tools.description: Move a document to a project or workspace. This can change who has access.

tools.name: publish_document
tools.description: Change publication and public access settings. Publishing can make content public.

tools.name: archive_document
tools.description: Archive a document using its current revision.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Delete a document and its pages.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project in your personal or organization workspace.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project's name, description, and instructions.

tools.name: move_project
tools.description: Move a project and its documents to another workspace.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project. Documents are released from the project and retained; their inherited access can change.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.description: List direct document or project shares and pending invitations.

tools.name: invite_share
tools.description: Grant document or project access to one user, email, or phone recipient. Invitations send notifications.

tools.name: update_share
tools.description: Change an existing access grant's role.

tools.name: remove_share
tools.description: Revoke a direct access grant or pending invitation.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
